description: This PHP source file defines a command class GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand used to generate Doctrine ORM proxy classes within the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to configure and execute the command, utilizing Doctrine ORM setup, and interacts with the system configuration to determine proxy class directory and plugin entity paths.

classes.name: GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand
classes.description: A command class for generating Doctrine ORM proxy classes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base Command class and implements the specific execution logic for proxy class generation.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, which is 'orm:generate-proxies'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the generation of Doctrine proxy classes by configuring the EntityManager, fetching metadata, and calling the proxy factory. It outputs success message upon completion.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Collects and returns the file paths of entity classes from configured plugin paths.
